Run a deterministic JavaScript workflow in the background. Use ONLY when the user explicitly requested a workflow, named workflow, or multi-agent orchestration. Prefer direct tools/local code for search, parsing, filtering, aggregation, tests, and other mechanical work; do not pay agents to execute known commands or verify test exit codes.

Choose script (inline JavaScript), scriptPath (existing file), or name (saved workflow). The tool saves inline scripts and returns their path and run ID; reuse scriptPath/name instead of resending source. args is an actual JSON value, not a JSON-encoded string.

Scripts begin with a pure literal:
export const meta = {name:'task', description:'One-line task', phases:[{title:'Scan'}]};
phase('Scan');
const results = await pipeline(args, item => agent(`Investigate ${item}`, {label:item}));
return results.filter(Boolean);

No TypeScript, filesystem, Node APIs, eval, Function, Date.now(), Math.random(), or argless new Date(). Pass timestamps/random inputs through args. Standard JSON/Array/Object/string operations run locally without model calls.

Hooks:
- agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<string|object|null>. Each call spends model tokens. opts: label, phase, agentType, model, effort, isolation:'worktree', gate:'shell command', schema:JSONSchema, resume:'prior label'. Omit model/effort to inherit; choose worktree only for conflicting parallel edits. schema returns validated StructuredOutput, not prose. Failure/skip returns null; filter it before downstream work. resume reuses that child's context and cannot combine with agentType/model/effort/isolation/gate/schema.
- gate runs a local command after the agent and fails on a nonzero exit; use this rather than an agent judging test results.
- pipeline(items, ...stages): each item's stages run in order, different items concurrently. Stage receives (previousResult, originalItem, index). Throw drops that item to null. Prefer this for independent work.
- parallel(thunks): await all; ordinary per-item failures become null, fatal cap/nested-load errors throw. Use a barrier only when downstream work needs all prior results together.
- phase(title), log(message): local progress display. Use matching titles in meta.phases; explicit opts.phase avoids concurrent phase races.
- workflow(nameOrRef, args?): nested saved workflow (name or {scriptPath}); shares limits and cancellation. One nesting level.
- budget.total is null; budget.spent() reports output tokens; budget.remaining() is Infinity. No automatic spend target is implied.

Concurrency is bounded by min(16, CPUs-2), total agents by 1000, pipeline/parallel input by 4096. These are safety ceilings, not recommended scale. Use the fewest model calls needed; deduplicate and validate locally before spawning more agents. Do not infer permission for a workflow from a task's complexity.

Completion sends a notification; inspect with get_subagent_result or /agents. Resume a stopped/completed run using {scriptPath, resumeFromRunId}: unchanged successful leading agent calls replay locally at no model cost. First changed/new/failed call ends replay; later calls run live. Same session only. Inspect the saved .workflow.jsonl journal to diagnose results before retrying paid work.
